programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Pogoń Szczecin – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In recent years, the Port team came close to winning the Polish Cup and winning the Ekstraklasa podium. Robert Kolendowicz, Pogoń's coach, assures that the failures have not hampered the team. In his opinion, the Pride of Pomerania is much more hungry for success than its most dangerous rivals in the country. This is reflected in the movements of Szczecin's players on the transfer market. In the ongoing window, the Navy and Burgundy squad was strengthened by, among others: midfielder José Pozo from Śląsk and Paul Mukairu - former winger of FC Copenhagen. From Pogoń's perspective, however, the key factor may be the fact that despite interest from foreign clubs, Efthymios Koulouris, who scored 28 goals in the last Ekstraklasa season, will not leave the team. In the second round of the 2025/26 campaign, Portowcy will be tested by Motor Lublin. The ambitions of the Yellow-White-Blue are much higher than their seventh place at the end of the previous competition. Motor, on the other hand, wants to show that he has established himself among the elite and poses a real threat to the league leaders. We'll see if he will make a comeback from the match from November last year, when he defeated Pogoń 4:2

programme.desc: The first El Derbi Madrileno this season. Atletico's last three league clashes with Real ended in 1-1 draws. programme.title: d/f The Lost Continent of the Pacific
programme.desc: Legends about lost civilizations have haunted the minds of people since time immemorial. During the era of great geographical discoveries, explorers were looking for a mysterious country, which they called “terra incognita” (unknown country) in the depths of the world's oceans. Today, the elders of the people living on Easter Island claim that their predecessors came to this land from a continent called Khiva, which they believe sank into the ocean after some kind of natural disaster. Today, new scientific evidence points to the existence of a group of islands in Polynesia that were the center of an ancient civilization. For almost 400 years, these islands were known as the Marquesas Archipelago, and the aborigines living in Polynesia simply call them the “Hiva Islands”. Could they be the remnants of the lost continent of Khiva? Using the latest archaeological and geological data, oral legends, and centuries-old navigational techniques, we uncover these mysteries in The Lost Continent of the Pacific: A World of Water and Exploration, a series that tells the story of human sacrifice and the ancient sailors who crossed the vast ocean centuries before Columbus reached the Americas. USA, 2011

programme.title: d/f Open Atlantis
programme.desc: James Cameron and Simcha Jacobovitch embark on an exciting adventure in search of the lost city of Atlantis. Using Plato as a virtual treasure map, they explore various hypotheses for the location of the mythical civilization, including Santorini, Malta and southern Spain. A team of professors from the United States, Canada, Israel and New Zealand analyzes archaeological sites and satellite photographs to determine the most plausible versions. The film also examines theories surrounding Gibraltar and the islands of the Azores archipelago, concluding with an analysis of southwestern Iberia as a potential center of an ancient maritime civilization. This investigation offers viewers a unique opportunity to explore one of the greatest mysteries in human history. USA, 2016

programme.title: Arabian Seas: Magicians Of the Reef (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2017. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Reef Wrecks: Florida Keys Shipwreck Trail (S1E2). Documentary about nature. USA, Canada, 2016. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep2 «Reef Wrecks»…The Florida Keys is the first line of defense for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it's easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks | This show takes the viewer on an underwater journey of discovery to explore the hidden world of sunken wrecks. The ocean floor is littered with centuries' worth of vessels that met an unfortunate end and were dragged to the depths. However, over many years, these wrecks have been transformed into artificial reefs that provide shelter and home to a multitude of plant and animal marine life. Each episode focuses on different locations such as the unique collection of wrecks found around the small Caribbean island of Bonaire; the vessels that were deliberately scuppered off the coast of Roatan; the wrecks around the coast of the Yucatan peninsula that provide a special environment for sweepers, groupers and the whale shark to thirve; and the ruined planes and ships surrounding New Providence in the Bahamas that were used in Hollywood movies | Director: Andrew Killawee

programme.title: The Living Beach: Nova Scotia (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2016. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep2 «The Living Beach»…Can conservationists keep the «100 Wild Islands» wild? How do migrating sandpipers live off the beach, anyways? This tour of Nova Scotia's coastline digs into the Bay of Fundy, the beaches of Burntcoat Head, and the surfers' paradise at Lawrencetown Beach | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: d/s Underwater Universe. Revival of nature
programme.desc: Marine life, under threat from human activity, needs protection more than ever. The series showcases the diversity of ocean ecosystems and explains what steps we must take to preserve them for future generations. We'll delve into the hidden lives of sea creatures, which include many unique species that remain beyond our reach, and show how important these ecosystems are to all life on the planet. Director: Miguel Angel Coba. UK, 2018

programme.title: d/f South Africa – On the back of a dragon
programme.desc: Discover South Africa - a land of contrasts, full of mysteries and natural wonders. In this documentary, the filmmakers take to the skies to bring you breathtaking views of mountain peaks, vast expanses of oceans and endless plains. Together with them you will go on a journey through wild places where rare animals live, and get acquainted with the culture and history of this amazing region

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 5 s.
programme.desc: Two puppies have been rushed to hospital following a suspected encounter with a deadly cane toad. A stray cat found on the Gold Coast has miraculously survived. Cast: Andrew Marchevsky, Chris Brown, Lisa Chimes, Tim Faulkner, Ben Dessen, Elissa Sursara, Dean Gladstone, Trent "Maxi" Maxwell, Steve Oemcke. Australia, 2009

programme.title: d/f Sunken Forest
programme.desc: Each subsequent release of the film will tell about the seasons when the water level in the Amazon reaches its maximum and rises to 28 meters. All land creatures rush to the hills in an attempt to escape the flood to higher places that the water cannot reach. 2016

programme.title: d/s Incredible life in Africa. Strange Encounters in Savannah
programme.desc: By shining a light on the biggest, fiercest and most powerful animals, we'll discover whether frogs may be the strongest animals, how big a web can be, and who has the biggest fangs. France, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Fresh waters
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Madagascar
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties. Conditions of engagement
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating ways animals find their perfect mate. Find out how creatures fall in love, create families, and decide to mate for the long haul. Then consider whether flirting is a skill that only humans can master. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: along with volcanoes. 1 p.
programme.desc: A journey of volcanic water from the Manziana caldera to Lake Bracciano, through the hilly and still wild land of the Etruscans in central Italy

programme.title: d/f Spain. Rabbit land
programme.desc: More than two thousand years ago, the Roman Empire extended into the Iberian Peninsula, then known as Spain. This region got its name, which translated from Latin means “country of rabbits,” thanks to the huge number of these animals. But rabbits were only part of the amazing mosaic that made this Roman province unique. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: top predators. Italian bears
programme.desc: No one could bet on the outcome of the appearance of seven Slovenian bears, two males and five females, in the forests of Adamello in Trentino. Italy, 2018

programme.title: d/s The last inhabitants of the reefs. Last survivors of the coral reefs
programme.desc: Dive into the mysterious underwater world with this documentary series! This project will tell about the life of coral reefs, their inhabitants and the unique ecosystems that they support. You will witness incredible stories of survival, struggle for territory and adaptation of sea creatures. 2018

programme.title: d/f Ibex: acrobats on the rocks
programme.desc: The documentary introduces us to the amazing inhabitants of the Alps - the Ibex, or Alpine ibex. These animals live on the steep slopes of the Gran Paradiso National Park in Italy. Hardy, graceful and incredibly agile, they have adapted to life in the harsh conditions of the highlands. France, 2021

programme.title: d/s Arsenal of animals. Deadly poison
programme.desc: Animals like frogs, moths, snakes and spiders have venom glands, while stone fish and scorpion fish have poisonous spines. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2016

programme.title: d/f Wild Heart of Spain
programme.desc: The Iberian Peninsula is a corner where two continents intersect: Europe and Africa. This is a unique place where nature is full of contrasts and richness, and animals have to fight for survival in the face of sudden changes in landscapes and seasons. We take a journey through Spanish lands to see how animals, from predators to herbivores, adapt to these harsh conditions and survive at the intersection of two worlds. Spain, 2019

programme.title: d/f Giants of Wildlife. 3 s.
programme.desc: There are animals of different sizes in nature, and the larger ones face the difficulty of always being visible. However, despite this, they have learned to turn their size into an advantage. In the film we will meet such giants of nature who skillfully adapted to the conditions of wild life, using their power, strength and size to survive. 2023

programme.title: d/f Green Belt of Europe
programme.desc: The Iron Curtain once divided Europe, creating a neutral zone with barbed wire, patrols and strict borders. programme.title: d/f Cheetah. From hunter to prey
programme.desc: This program takes us into the world of wildlife, where cheetahs are constantly fighting for survival. We will see their life path from cubs to adults, reveal the peculiarities of daytime hunting and learn how much strength speed takes away, as a result of which other predators often take away the cheetah’s prey. The survival of the fastest beast on Earth involves overcoming many difficulties, and this struggle cannot but inspire admiration. The cheetah is a perfect creature, the fastest land animal among mammals. Of all the representatives of the cat family, this animal is one of the most adapted to life in its habitat, the African savannah. Thanks to its impeccable aerodynamic body structure with an incredibly flexible back, powerful muscles and long legs, the cheetah reaches speeds of over one hundred kilometers per hour in a few seconds! A rather massive tail allows it to change direction with lightning speed in pursuit of ungulates running in zigzags, and an intensely working heart and lungs make it possible to run at top speeds. Spain, 2016

programme.title: d/s Wild Mind. Tools

programme.desc: Câu chuyện về cuộc chiến của Mỹ nhằm kiểm soát vùng biển chống lại những chiếc U-boat đáng sợ của Đức ở Đại Tây Dương và Hải quân đáng sợ của Nhật Bản ở Thái Bình Dương cuối cùng đã xoay chuyển tình thế của cuộc chiến.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP06
programme.desc: Sau cuộc tấn công Trân Châu Cảng, quân Nhật càn quét khắp Đông Nam Á. Tại Guadalcanal, Thủy quân lục chiến Hoa Kỳ được giao nhiệm vụ đẫm máu là ngăn chặn bước tiến không ngừng nghỉ của họ.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP01

programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: NHIỆM VỤ NGUY HIỂM - MUNITIONS HIJACKING CASE
programme.desc: Đặc vụ Wen được giao nhiệm vụ bí mật cho một đại lý vũ khí ở Đông Nam Á để xác định vị trí và phá hủy kho đạn dược. Tuy nhiên, cuối cùng khi tìm thấy chúng, anh bị tấn công bởi những tên xã hội đen vô danh và phải hợp tác với đồng đội của mình để thu hồi vũ khí và ngăn chặn thảm họa.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ TỬ THẦN - AGENT OF DEATH
programme.desc: Sau khi trải qua một thí nghiệm bí mật của chính phủ, đặc vụ Tara của CIA có được khả năng biến hình thành bất kỳ ai thông qua quá trình biến đổi DNA, khiến cô trở thành kẻ xâm nhập tối thượng. programme.desc: Phim được chuyển thể từ sự kiện có thật. Thám tử Lin thành lập một đơn vị đặc biệt để bắt giữ tên cướp xe máy và tổ chức tội phạm đứng sau vụ trộm ở Phật Sơn. Trong quá trình đó, người vợ đang mang thai của anh bị một tên cướp xe máy đâm phải, khiến anh phát hiện ra kế hoạch trả thù của chúng...

programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…
